title: From Imbalance to Evidence: Deep Nonparametric Testing for Complex Data under Severe Sample Imbalance
abstract: arXiv:2610.12946v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Comparing distributions under severe sample imbalance requires effectively using abundant majority observations while retaining sensitivity to differences involving the smaller sample. This challenge is particularly relevant for complex, non-Euclidean data, such as graphs, whose structural characteristics call for flexible testing procedures. Classifier two-sample tests (C2STs) provide such flexibility, but existing procedures are primarily designed for balanced or comparably sized samples. In this paper, we study C2STs in a highly imbalanced regime, and show that severe sample imbalance may substantially degrade testing performance. Different from conventional imbalanced learning approaches that treat sample imbalance merely as a nuisance for classifier training, we turn it into a source of repeated testing evidence. translated_title: 从不平衡到证据：严重样本不平衡下复杂数据的深度非参数检验
translated_abstract: 在严重样本不平衡的情况下比较分布，需要有效利用数量占多数的丰富观测数据，同时对涉及较小样本的差异保持敏感性。这一挑战对于图等复杂的非欧几里得数据尤为突出，因为其结构特征需要灵活的检验方法。基于分类器的双样本检验提供了这种灵活性，但现有方法主要是针对平衡或规模相近的样本设计的。本文研究了高度不平衡情形下的C2ST，并表明严重的样本不平衡可能会显著降低检验性能。与传统的将样本不平衡仅视为分类器训练中不利因素的不平衡学习方法不同，我们将其转化为可重复检验证据的来源。基于这一见解，我们提出了一种增强型不平衡感知深度分类器双样本检验，这是一种分类……
tldr: 提出增强型不平衡感知深度分类器双样本检验，创新性地将严重样本不平衡从分类器训练的不利因素转化为可重复利用的检验证据来源，从而在高不平衡情形下实现对图等复杂数据更可靠的分布比较。
en_tdlr: Proposes EIAD-C2ST, which innovatively turns severe sample imbalance from a mere nuisance in classifier training into a source of repeated testing evidence, enabling more reliable two-sample distribution testing for complex data such as graphs under high imbalance.
